fields.description: When disabled, no Sales Invoice is submitted and the hooks do nothing.
fields.label: Enable Malaysia e-Invoicing

fields.description: Sandbox talks to preprod-api.myinvois.hasil.gov.my, Production to api.myinvois.hasil.gov.my.
fields.label: Environment

fields.description: Submit a Sales Invoice to MyInvois automatically when it is submitted.
fields.label: Submit Automatically on Sales Invoice Submit

fields.description: Try to cancel the e-Invoice at MyInvois when the Sales Invoice is cancelled. LHDN only allows cancellation within 72 hours of validation.
fields.label: Cancel e-Invoice when Sales Invoice is Cancelled

fields.description: Queue on the short queue instead of long. Only useful for very low volume sites.
fields.label: Use Short Queue

fields.description: Allow invoices to be billed to LHDN's General Public buyer (EI00000000010) — required for B2C / consolidated e-Invoices.
fields.label: Allow General Public Buyer

fields.description: Client ID created in the MyInvois portal (Taxpayer System > MyInvois System > Integration).
fields.label: Client ID

fields.description: Only for intermediary systems submitting on behalf of a taxpayer: that taxpayer's TIN.
fields.label: On Behalf Of (Intermediary TIN)

fields.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for every MyInvois call.
fields.label: Request Timeout (seconds)

fields.description: How many times a throttled (HTTP 429) or gateway-failing (HTTP 5xx) request is retried.
fields.label: Max Retries

fields.description: Used when neither the item nor the invoice line carries an MSIC code.
fields.label: Default Classification (MSIC) Code

fields.description: 01 Sales Tax, 02 Service Tax, 03 Tourism Tax, 04 High-Value Goods Tax, 05 Sales Tax on LVG, 06 Not Applicable, E Tax Exemption.
fields.label: Default Tax Type

fields.description: Map each tax liability account used on Sales Invoices to a MyInvois tax type (and its rate) so mixed-rate invoices are reported correctly.
fields.label: Tax Account Mapping
